# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest published `files-sdk` release (built from `main`) receives security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **don't** open a public issue for a vulnerability. Report it privately through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting: go to the repository's [Security tab](https://github.com/haydenbleasel/files-sdk/security) and choose **Report a vulnerability** (or open [the advisory form](https://github.com/haydenbleasel/files-sdk/security/advisories/new) directly).

Include the affected subpath (e.g. `files-sdk/api`, `files-sdk/s3`), the version, and a minimal reproduction. You'll get a reply there, and the fix and advisory are coordinated in that private thread before disclosure.
